name: glm-web
description: Web research and content acquisition plugin bundling five skills: glm-web-search (zero-dependency local web search CLI), glm-web-reader (webpage main-content extraction CLI), glm-multi-search-engine (aggregation of eight Chinese search engines with advanced operators), glm-agent-browser (headless browser automation for navigation, clicks and snapshots) and glm-contentanalysis (unified content extraction and insight routing). Trigger for any web search, page reading, browser automation or content analysis task. This plugin is the common foundation referenced by 20+ other GLM skills — install it first.

interface.shortDescription: Web research foundation: search, page reading, multi-engine aggregation, headless browsing and content analysis.
interface.longDescription: GLM Web Research is the common foundation for the whole GLM skill family: more than 20 other skills reference its CLIs. glm-web-search runs a zero-dependency search over public engines (glmws.py), glm-web-reader extracts main content from any URL (glmwr.py), glm-multi-search-engine aggregates eight Chinese search engines with advanced operators (mse.py), glm-agent-browser drives a headless browser for navigation, clicks and snapshots, and glm-contentanalysis routes videos, podcasts and articles into tailored wisdom extraction. All scripts are pure standard-library; install this plugin first and other GLM skills can call its CLIs directly.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-web plugin skills: <搜索网页 / 读取网页正文 / 多引擎检索 / 无头浏览器 / 内容萃取>
